column3: Twin islets west of central Key Lento. Look through wreckage beside the blue boat on the beach.
Long north-south island west of Key Lento. Search its south tip beside the red debris and dark plants.
Rocky sandbar west of Key Lento and just north of the curved mangrove island. Search among the exposed rocks.
Small wedge-shaped sandbar west of northern Key Lento, toward Gambit Bay. Search sand by the plants on its southeast shore.
Small curved island in the eastern Shoeless Keys, north of Gambit Bay and west of the highway. Walk to the northeast beach.
Hook-shaped mangrove island west of Key Lento. Look under the mangroves where sand opens up away from the water.
column4: Examine the bottle for note 6/6. A second map clue points to the east side of the low hill.
